copy.facebook:
We need to talk about the 'Originality' myth. I see so many brilliant students burning themselves out trying to create a revolutionary new idea for their assignments, only to end up with a low grade because their work lacks academic rigour.

Here is the difference between an average paper and a First Class submission:

THE 54% TRAP: Trying to invent an entirely novel theoretical model from scratch, but only ending up with an unsubstantiated opinion piece.

THE 78%+ REWRITE: Contrasting opposing empirical studies, critiquing their sampling limitations, and synthesizing a justified academic position.

Markers aren't grading your creativity; they are grading your ability to engage with the literature. If you're stuck staring at your draft and feeling like you aren't saying anything 'new,' you’re likely overthinking it. Let us help you shift the focus to what actually counts.
